citation: Tien MZ et al. (2013), PLoS ONE 8:e80635, Table 1; Miller scale reproduced there.
threshold_rule: strictly_less_than; numerical sensitivity diagnostics, not validated biological core/surface labels
terminal_policy: retain original row; leave normalization blank for chain ends

caveat: Reference maxima were evaluated using DSSP; applying them to Biopython ShrakeRupley ASA is a normalization convention, not proof of algorithm-equivalent RSA. Both use a 1.4 angstrom solvent probe.
